sn33.2:1.2: nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn33.2:1.3: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti ||
sn33.2:1.5: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 4
sn33.2:1.6: Vedanāya kho Vaccha aññāṇā vedanāsamudaye aññāṇā vedanānirodhe aññāṇā vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇā || ||
sn33.2:1.7: Evam imāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti || ||
sn33.2:1.8: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
sn33.2:1.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ti || || 5
sn33.2:1.10: Ayaṃ kho Vaccha hetu ayam paccayo yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti
sn33.2:1.11: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato loko ti vā || pe ||
